title: Invented assured shorthold tenancy agreement, 27 clauses

questions.question: How many weeks' rent is the deposit?

spans.quote: The deposit is £2,128.85, being five weeks' rent.

questions.note: Clause 6.1 says the HOLDING deposit is one week's rent; a model that answers one week has read the wrong clause.

questions.question: Is this a tenancy or a licence?
questions.question_zh: 這是租約還是使用許可？

spans.quote: a licence to occupy and does not create an assured shorthold tenancy

questions.note: The title line says ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCY AGREEMENT and clause 2.3 contradicts it. The answer is in clause 2.3, not the heading.

questions.question: How much notice must the tenant give to end the agreement early, and from what point in the term may that notice be given?
questions.question_zh: 提前退租要提前多久通知？從第幾個月起才能發？

answer.text: two months' written notice, on or after the sixth month of the term

spans.quote: On or after the sixth month of the Term either party may end this agreement by giving

questions.note: Clause 22.40 also carries a one month's notice, for house rules. Different clause, different subject.

questions.question: What is the energy rating letter?

spans.quote: shows a current rating of C

questions.note: The potential rating is B. The question asks for the current one.

questions.question: Does the flat come with a parking space, and if so what does it cost?
questions.question_zh: 這戶有附停車位嗎？要多少錢？
questions.note: Clause 22.51 mentions a bay allotted to another flat. That is a near miss grep will surface: the agreement never says this flat has one, or a price.

questions.question: How much is the pet deposit or the pet rent?
questions.question_zh: 養寵物要加收多少押金或租金？

spans.quote: No pet is kept at the Property without the Landlord's written consent

questions.note: Clause 20.1 permits a cat or a small dog with written consent and is silent about money. That clause IS the evidence for the no, so it is a gold span: a model that says absent and quotes it has shown its work.
